subject: math

objective.text: Solve word problems involving the total value of a group of coins.

explanations.title: Read, Draw, Write
explanations.text: Read the problem. Draw and label. Write number sentences. Write a statement. Reread and adjust as you work.

explanations.title: Put together
explanations.text: When coins are in two places, find the value of each group. Then add the two values. A tape diagram with two parts shows this.

explanations.title: Take from
explanations.text: When coins are given away, find the value given. Subtract it from what you started with. A number bond shows the whole and the parts.

explanations.title: Many ways to add coins
explanations.text: You can count from the largest coin, skip-count, or make a ten. Pick a way that makes the adding easy.

explanations.title: Skip-count dollars
explanations.text: Count ten-dollar bills by tens. Count five-dollar bills by fives. You can cross a hundred.

source_ref.section: Fluency: Skip-Count by $5 and $10 Between 85 and 205

examples.title: Ignacio's pockets
examples.text: Pocket 1: 3 dimes and 2 nickels is 40 cents. Pocket 2: 1 quarter and 7 pennies is 32 cents. 40 plus 32 equals 72. Ignacio has 72 cents.

examples.title: Reese's money
examples.text: Reese gave away 35 cents and 39 cents. That is 74 cents. 94 minus 74 equals 20. Reese has 20 cents now.

questions.text: You have 85 dollars in bills. You add ten-dollar bills. How many dollars is 85 plus 10 plus 10 plus 10?
You have 115 dollars and take away 2 ten-dollar bills. How many dollars do you have?
You have 185 dollars. You add three five-dollar bills. How many dollars do you have?
Danny has 2 dimes, 1 quarter, 3 nickels and 5 pennies. What is the total value, in cents?
Show two different ways Danny might add to find the total.
What do we do first when we see a word problem?
Ignacio has 3 dimes and 2 nickels in one pocket. How many cents are in that pocket?
His other pocket has 1 quarter and 7 pennies. How many cents are in that pocket?
How much money is in both of Ignacio's pockets?
Tamika has 12 pennies and 2 quarters in her piggy bank. She puts in 4 nickels, 1 dime and 4 more pennies. How much money does she have altogether, in cents?
Reese gave her sister 2 dimes and 3 nickels on Monday. How many cents is that?
On Tuesday, Reese gave her sister 1 quarter, 1 dime and 4 pennies. How many cents is that?
How many cents did Reese give her sister in all?
Reese started with 94 cents. How much money does she have now, in cents?

questions.text: Reese started with 94 cents. That is the whole. What is the part she gave away, and what is the part she has left?
Grace has 3 dimes, 2 nickels and 12 pennies. How much money does she have, in cents?
Lisa has 2 dimes and 4 pennies in one pocket, and 4 nickels and 1 quarter in the other. How much money does she have in all, in cents?
Mamadou found 39 cents last week. This week he found 2 nickels, 4 dimes and 5 pennies. How much money does he have altogether, in cents?
Emanuel had 53 cents. He gave 1 dime and 1 nickel to his brother. How much money does he have left, in cents?
The top drawer has 2 quarters and 14 pennies. The bottom drawer has 7 pennies, 2 nickels and 1 dime. What is the total value of the money in both drawers, in cents?
Ricardo has 3 quarters, 1 dime, 1 nickel and 4 pennies. He gave 68 cents to his friend. How much money does he have left, in cents?
Greg had 1 quarter, 1 dime and 3 nickels. He found 3 more nickels. How much money does he have, in cents?
Robert gave Sandra 1 quarter, 5 nickels and 2 pennies. Sandra already had 3 pennies and 2 dimes. How much money does Sandra have now, in cents?
Owen has 4 dimes, 3 nickels and 16 pennies. How much money does he have, in cents?
Eli found 1 quarter, 1 dime and 2 pennies in his desk. He found 16 pennies and 2 dimes in his backpack. How much money does he have in all, in cents?
Carrie had 2 dimes, 1 quarter and 11 pennies. She bought a soft pretzel for 35 cents. How much money does she have left, in cents?
Ethan had 67 cents. He gave 1 quarter and 6 pennies to his sister. How much money does he have left, in cents?
Susan's piggy bank has 4 dimes and 3 nickels. Nevaeh's has 17 pennies and 3 nickels. What is the total value of the money in both piggy banks, in cents?
Tison had 1 quarter, 4 dimes, 4 nickels and 5 pennies. He gave 57 cents to his cousin. How much money does he have left, in cents?
How could you think about the nickels to make them easier to count?
How does understanding place value help you find the value of coins?
How are number bonds and part-whole tape diagrams the same and different?
What is 10 minus 3?
